note: the expedition leaves Cape Columbia for the Polar Ocean
the Big Lead: six days lost waiting for it to close
Marvin turns back from 86 degrees 38 minutes; he died on the return
Bartlett turned back from 87 degrees 47 minutes, the last man with the party able to take an independent observation
Peary's claimed farthest north, with Henson, Ootah, Egingwah, Seegloo and Ooqueah
